title: Settings: full-width Save button, resolve Manage catalog alignment
goal: Settings' Save button was wrapped in a horizontal flex row that shrank it to content width, instead of the reference's full-width primary CTA; the 'Manage catalog' link's self-start alignment needed checking against the reference.
in_scope: settings-form.tsx's Save button becomes a direct flex-col child of its Card so it can stretch full-width
Investigate 'Manage catalog' link's self-start alignment against the reference and either fix it or document why it's a deliberate, existing app-wide convention
out_of_scope: Any other Settings page field or section
acceptance: settings-form.tsx's Save button is a direct flex-col child of its Card (matching the reference's full-width primary CTA) instead of wrapped in a horizontal flex row. The 'Manage catalog' link's self-start alignment is reconciled against the reference — if it's a deliberate app-wide convention used consistently elsewhere, that finding is documented instead of changed blind.
invariants: Save button's submit behavior unchanged — layout only
